Metro: Exodus is the third installment of the Metro games, based on novels by Dmitri Glukhovsky. Dmitri is a science fiction author who is also famous for his efforts as a war journalist. The Metro series is a post-apocalypse franchise that deals with the survivors of a nuclear apocalypse fleeing underground into the subway systems […]
